title: Rito Gear

{{Infobox Item |image= File:BotW Swallow Bow Icon.png |caption= A [[Swallow Bow]] |pronunciation= |plural= |type= |game= BotW, TotK |other= AoC |cost= |value= |location= |uses= {{List| * Attacking [[Enemy|Enemies]] * Defense }} |strength= |durability= |comp= |sample= |theme= }} The {{Term/Store|Rito Gear|Rito Gear|Series, BotW, AoC}} is a recurring archetype of [[Weapon]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 172}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Rito Gear is weaponry crafted by the [[Rito]]. It is designed to be both lightweight and sturdy, in order to be usable by Rito warriors during flight.{{Cite|{{Big|Feathered Edge}}
Rito craftsmen forged this lightweight, double-edged sword so Rito warriors could soar into battle unhindered by its weight.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Feathered Spear}}
'Its lightweight design is a hallmark of Rito craftsmanship. It's made from light and sturdy materials, which afford Rito warriors ease of use during aerial combat.|Inventory|BotW}} Rito [[Bow]]s are also engineered for swift aerial combat, and they are designed to be drawn faster than normal Bows in order to afford a higher rate of fire.{{Cite|{{Big|Swallow Bow}}
This bow is a favorite among Rito warriors. The bowstring has been specially engineered for aerial combat, which allows it to be drawn faster than a normal bow.|Inventory|BotW}}{{Cite|{{Big|Falcon Bow}}
A highly refined Rito-made bow created by a master Rito craftsman. Rito warriors favor it for its superior rate of fire, which helps them excel even further at aerial combat.|Inventory|BotW}} A majority of Rito Gear is constructed out of wood, which makes them vulnerable to burning when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], they cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]], and they will not conduct [[Electricity]] or attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s. The inverse is true of the [[Feathered Edge]] and [[Feathered Spear]], which are made out of metal. ====List of Equipment==== {| class="wikitable" style="width:100%; max-width:57.5em; text-align:center" |- !style="width:25%"| Item !style="width:10%"| Strength !style="width:10%"| Durability !style="width:55%"| Description |- | [[File:BotW Feathered Edge Icon.png|link=]]
